content: Day/night mood systems use 4 key phases (dawn, midday, dusk, midnight/night) with AnimationCurve-style curves for light intensity (e.g. rise to ~0.8 by midday, drop through afternoon) and keyed colors for sky/horizon/ground/fog per phase; continuity rule: last color of a phase must equal first color of the next. Works fine without sun movement in fixed-view/isometric games - only colors, intensities and fog change. Night is never black: darkest-night reference values keep a blue floor (0,0,10-style, i.e. dark blue not black). Sources: seaotter.games day/night blog, sine.space wiki, urho3d forum.
